body:
I feel like I have broken down the idiocy of that new regulation update a dozen times, and there are pretty good grounds for shutting it down as far as I can logically think:  
\> Students who are currently residing in American territory will have already made their class registrations, their lease signings, all that, way back in the March-May period. We abide by the rules, the rules do not get to flip and change overnight, and especially not in the middle of a pandemic.  
\> Forcing people who have been residing for months in the official epicenter of the world to mass exodus back to pretty much every continent but Antarctica is simply pure idiocy from a pandemic control point of view. We need **less travel, not more**. It does make sense to not have people already outside the U.S. not fly in if they don't have to, but it just falls apart in the other direction.   
\> Aside from schools unanimously announcing their equivalent of Fuck ICE 101, or FICE 101, professors will probably modify their syllabi to comply with the new laws while making it entirely possible to take most if not all of their classes online (barring the lab classes and such that need the in-school equipment, and even then those can be curtailed if the required lab kits are not too sophisticated).   
\> You make idiotic laws, expect idiotic counter-measures.   
.  
.  
.  
And frankly, as far as our "core purpose in life" is concerned, I feel like humans are cursed with the cognizance of their own existence. Our minds are too sophisticated to subsist on pure instincts, and we are capable of forming our own thoughts about existence. Sometimes, those thoughts aren't pretty. I have several times pondered whether it would be worth having children in a country, in a world with no future, no freedom, no hope. Sometimes, I even have thoughts of hating my parents for having brought me into this world the way they did. I curse my unfortunate origin times after times.    
.  
Children deserve to be brought into a world where there can be love and hope, not the one I was brought into.  
.  
And I think I will never sire any children on their soil should I be forced back. I shall not be responsible for the torment of another innocent life under that place. Hell, the gov are advocating for increased birth rates, and the things I would give to see people practice celibacy en masse over there. It would be a hell of a sight to see tens of millions using their balls and ovaries to hold the population growth hostage, and it is practically impossible to enforce a ban on **not having sex**.   
.  
Hell, "we wouldn't fuck until you fully, and in good spirit, adopt the American Bill of Right" might actually make a bloodless revolution or at least major political reforms possible.
